description: This file defines the FavoritesController class, responsible for handling HTTP requests related to favoriting and unfavoriting articles in the web application. It uses dependency injection for IMediator to coordinate commands and responses, and restricts access via authorization schemes.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller to manage favoriting actions on articles, including adding and deleting favorites.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to add an article to favorites.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove an article from favorites.
